book.name: Matyu
book.title: God tal ol na tongwo ha maing yal Matyu mining bongwo dimia.

content: Seten ure Yisas kela kul tongwo ha
Ena God Kwiang Yisas aule ire ganba po engwo gul i ongwi. Ongwiwe, Seten ure, kraung sire, kera kul tenama dire, aule ongwi. Ongure Yisas homena nekirere, simo pare pare mongwi.
Mongwo hamen haung iwe, yal su kebering aling poti mongwi. Molere Yisas menan gobari gole mongwi.
Mongure Seten kera hong yal i mala ungwi. Urere yu ditongwi, “Ni God wang weni monanga, kwahulu mala i dingere, u homena nangwo nenaminba”.
Dungure, Yisas yu dungwi, “Ha mining ganing ta yu pamia, Ari homena tani pirere, molkun ta olekinaminua. God grang bani wine olere, ari molkun onaminua.” (Diu 8:3)
Dungure kwia nigi dongwo singaba Yisas aule irere, ha maing bling mini oo bir bring bani ongwi.

Pi molere, yu ditongwi, “Ni God wang kara weni monanga, iri so. Iri sinanga, ta bolkinania, ha mining ganing ta yu pamiraya, God kwia ensel hobi grang ha ditongwo pirere ni kene ol momia. Ure ni aki dinangwo hulu kebin ta bolkinanga pamua.” (Sam 91:11-12)
Dungure Yisas Seten yu ditongwi, “I te, ha mining ta yu pamia, God kera kul tekio.” (Diu 6:16)
Yu dungure Seten Yisas hon aule ire, hamen hul mini bani ongwi. Pi molere, ganba ganba ari tabin tabin te, talhan maing maing don miki weni i tibi olere,
Yisas yu ditongwi, “Ni ikwi bol na tere, maa e na tenanga, talhan hanga hobi para muru ni ni teralua.”
Dimba Yisas Seten yu ditongwi, “Seten ni ere pa. Ha mining ta yu pamiraya, God tani weni maa e tenaminia. Terere honagi di na tongworai onaminga pamua.” (Diu 6:13)
Yu dungure Seten Yisas aidolere, ere ongwi. Ongure kwia ensel tau urere, Yisas kene ol te mongwi.
Yisas Galili malgi honagi kebering hongwo ha
Ena gin ta “Yon halabusi pamua” dungwo Yisas pirere, ere Galili ongwi.
Pirere Nasaret i holia olere, pi Kapaneam malgi ongwi. Malgi iwe, Galili nir digan bina Sebyulan Naptalai kunu holi mongwi.
Momia homa God hana togu yal Aisaia awa ha di engwo nima namua dimiraya.

Sebyulan ganba, te Naptalai ganba homaulung nir bina ere u Yodan ongwo kuni yawe. Galili yamoni mongwo yalhobo, yal al ha maing nomani si pirkirere, si bongwo ala mongwo hobi gin ta ha maing pirere, u ari sungwo bani monamua.
Yal al si bongwo ali mol parere, gol wai sinamba, ari si yalhobi mongwo bani enangure, u wai namua. (Ais 9:1-2)

Ena hongebe Kapaneam malgi, Yisas ha kebering holere nir si tongwi, “God kene ongwo maing omaga u tibi pi ni tomia, tal nigi dongwo ol wanga i nigi de pir tere, nomani si kulu sire, hon olkirala di pire wayo,” dungwi.
Yisas yal sui sui dire gala dungure doleng bongwo ha
Ena Yisas Galili nir digan bina ware hangure, ebering su Saimon haang hon Pita engwo yaliwe, ebering Endru kina mongwo hangwi. Hangure pisi gal pia si nir ala olere, pisi si mongwi.
Mongure Yisas yu ditongwi, “Ni yasuri ure na dolna bolo. Bonanga, honagi tau nibil di ni tegere, pisi honagi nega dire onga meri na honagi nega dire ole ari tau i na tenanua.”
Yu dungure pisi gal gintani pisolere, Yisas kina ereho ongwi.

Omia Yisas obilga wiyala pire hangure Sebedi wang Yems ebering Yon kina mongure hangwi. Yasuri sipi ala molere, irang kina pisi gal oulu dungwo guwa si mongure hangwi. Hanere Yisas yasuri gala dungwi.
Dungure yasuri sipi bani molere, irang Sebedi pisolere, ure Yisas kina ereho ongwi.
Yisas ari yal al miki weni awai ol tongwo ha

Omia aule ire pirere, Galili ganba bina holo holi para wa pa di pisolungwi. Warere ha maing oo ala ari God kene ongwo hol u tibi ongwo ha maing i di tibi ol tongwi. Terere, nibil ole mongwo hobi awai ol tongwi.

Ol tongwiwe, Yisas guung haang Siria ganba ongure, ari hobi pirere, nu nibil ya, nebona maing maing kwia nigi dongwo yong sina mongwo hobi ire, omeling male yadani sungwo hobi aule ire ungure, awai ol tongwi.
Ol tongure Galili ari ire, Dekapolis ari ire, Yerusalem ari ire, Yudia ari ire, Yodan hoibi hol bani iwo arihobi ire dire, Yisas doling bol ongwi.
